# Core Principles

Principle 5: Data at the Source. Within BDI, the party determining access and usage rights for a dataset, either the source party or a service provider, is considered the data holder conform the EU Data Act.

Policies govern access to data products and define the conditions under which they can be used. When data products are composed from multiple underlying sources, these policies must remain consistent.

As a data owner, one can always see who is requesting access to the data. Zero Trust: trust is never automatically granted. Local decision-making is based on the subsidiarity principle. Coherent Security means security on every level.
